verdict.rationale: Featurebase centralizes feedback with voting and AI-driven surfacing of 'the most impactful opportunities' (featurebase-docs-15, featurebase-docs-7). It also has a reports analytics engine (featurebase-docs-25). Its use of user attributes for segmentation (featurebase-docs-6) suggests customer data exists in the system, but that evidence concerns release notes, not feedback. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of customer context (account attributes, revenue/MRR, company data) shown alongside feedback posts, prioritization by customer segment or value, CRM integration for customer data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
